doc:
If `foApprox` is set to true, and some `aᵢ` is not a free variable,
then we use first-order unification
```
  ?m a_1 ... a_i a_{i+1} ... a_{i+k} =?= f b_1 ... b_k
```
reduces to
```
  ?m a_1 ... a_i =?= f
  a_{i+1}        =?= b_1
  ...
  a_{i+k}        =?= b_k
```
name: Lean.Meta.Config.foApprox
